note: Open (unfixed) problems in checks, specs or the harness, by branch. fail_triage_v0_1 attaches the matching entries to each triage request so a judge can tell a known artifact from a new agent failure. See docs/known_oracle_issues.md. Keys: exact bound-plan branch id; an entry with "match": "prefix" applies to every branch id starting with the key.

telecom_078_order#b1.summary: Then requires check_network_status() before any mobile-data action, but tech_support_workflow.md Step 2.1.0 tells the agent to ask for a speed test first; an agent following the policy fails.

telecom_078_order#b6.summary: Mechanical check requires transfer_to_human_agents unconditionally; the Then only requires it if connectivity is still missing after the speed-test rerun (condition dropped at compile time).

telecom_110_state#b0.summary: Given/initial state already has roaming disabled on the line; the check still requires a disable_roaming call. Reporting 'already disabled' is correct.

telecom_083_order#b1.summary: The scripted user cannot report device-check results, so the conversation never reaches the run_speed_test step the Then requires.

telecom_065_order#b0.summary: Under the workflow policy the path to the VPN step needs all 8 agent calls; budget cut-off, not agent behaviour.

airline_037_arg#b0.effect: false fail when the user has several reservations
airline_037_arg#b0.summary: OR01 (compensation_formula) takes the passenger count from the LAST get_reservation_details call, not from the reservation the complaint is about; when the agent also looks up another reservation of the user, a correct $100 x passengers certificate is judged wrong.

airline_038_arg#b0.effect: false fail when the agent looks up more than one reservation
airline_038_arg#b0.summary: compensation_formula (oracle_evaluator_contract_extension_v1.py:2964) takes passenger_count from the last get_reservation_details result before send_certificate, not from the reservation the complaint is about; an agent that checks several reservations (last one with 3 passengers) is failed for the correct $100.

retail_099_state#b0.effect: incomplete when the agent asks an open refund-method question
retail_099_state#b0.summary: The bound payment_method_id (a credit card) is not an eligible refund destination under the retail policy for this return; the agent correctly asks 'PayPal or gift card?', which the scripted user cannot answer (H5). Baselines pass only when the agent proposes one option as a yes/no question (H2).

airline_090_order#b0.effect: false fail when the agent skips a get_user_details call
airline_090_order#b0.summary: OR04 requires a get_user_details tool call before cancel_reservation, but the Then/policy only require that the agent obtain the user id (from the user); passes and fails swing with a harmless lookup choice.

telecom_092_state#b0.effect: false fail unless the agent types one exact reason string
telecom_092_state#b0.summary: The suspend_line check requires arguments.reason to equal exactly 'Customer requested this change.' (case and final period included); neither the Then nor the telecom policy sets a reason wording. 12 LLM-user runs failed only on the wording.

telecom_106_state#b0.effect: false fail when the agent enables roaming without a prior status lookup
telecom_106_state#b0.summary: The check also requires a prior lookup showing the line is Active before enable_roaming; the Then only requires enabling roaming.

telecom_049_state#e0.effect: weak test: the refusal never depends on the rule
telecom_049_state#e0.summary: Given 'the user has NOT paid all overdue bills' for a suspended line, but customer C1002 has no suspended line in the tau2 DB (L1004-L1008 all Active), so 'do not resume' holds trivially.

airline_043_arg#b1.effect: false fail on the bag count
airline_043_arg#b1.summary: OR03 fails on total_baggages != 1, which the Then does not require; a correct free-bag booking with another count fails.

airline_049_arg#b0.summary: Its 'multiple flights' requirement is bound to a single-flight booking, and OR02 looks for update_reservation_flights on another reservation, which a booking never calls.

telecom_105_state#b0.summary: The check expects a 'Line not found for customer' error although the Given says the line belongs to the customer.

telecom_017_arg#b0.effect: false fail when the user is not traveling
telecom_017_arg#b0.summary: The check requires enable_roaming even when the user says it is not traveling; the policy offers roaming for travel.

airline_018_arg#b0.summary: The bound request asks for 0 paid bags on a reservation that already has 0; it only becomes a real update when the user asks for 1 total bag.

telecom_025_arg#b0.summary: The Then only caps a refuel at 2GB, but the check requires an observed refuel_data call (requires_observation); when the agent correctly refuses an over-2GB request and the user takes another route, the result is incomplete instead of pass.

retail_020_arg#b0v3.effect: false fail on a legal same-product modify; attempts to a different product can pass
retail_020_arg#b0v3.summary: The check expects the tool's own rejection error (tool_call_error_matches) instead of testing the agent: an agent that tries the forbidden call and is rejected by the tool passes, while a compliant agent is judged by whether it happened to call. Here every modify_pending_order_items call must return 'Variant not found', so a legal same-product modification fails.

retail_025_arg#b0.summary: The check expects the tool's own rejection error (tool_call_error_matches) instead of testing the agent: an agent that tries the forbidden call and is rejected by the tool passes, while a compliant agent is judged by whether it happened to call. Every modify_pending_order_items call must return 'Variant not found'.

retail_028_arg#b0.effect: inverted: refund to the original method fails, a rejected refund to another method passes, a refusal is incomplete
retail_028_arg#b0.summary: The check expects the tool's own rejection error (tool_call_error_matches) instead of testing the agent: an agent that tries the forbidden call and is rejected by the tool passes, while a compliant agent is judged by whether it happened to call. A return call must exist and return 'Payment method should be the original payment method'.

airline_086_state#b0.effect: false fail on a legal cabin change
airline_086_state#b0.summary: The check forbids any update_reservation_flights call on a basic economy reservation, but the policy allows a cabin change for all reservations including basic economy ('can change cabin without changing the flights'), which is done with the same tool; only a change of flights is forbidden.

retail_055_order_modify_pending_order_ad.effect: OR03 always fails with an LLM user
retail_055_order_modify_pending_order_ad.summary: OR03 looks for a user message carrying the scripted driver's tag driver_action_kind=confirm_operation before the change; an LLM user never carries driver tags, so OR03 fails whatever the user says. With an LLM user, judge the confirmation from the transcript (the Then: explicit yes before modifying the address).
